description: This file defines the EngineChart class, which manages a collection of engine-related data points stored in a map, including constants for injectors, sparks, and trigger signals, as well as methods to access and interpret this data, such as retrieving a revolution log.

classes.name: EngineChart
classes.description: Represents a collection of engine data points, identified by string keys, providing methods to access and interpret engine-related information.

methods.name: EngineChart
methods.description: Constructor initializing the EngineChart with a map of data.

methods.name: getRevolutionsLog
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the revolutions log from the stored data.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the StringBuilder associated with a given key.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the EngineChart object.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns the internal map of data.
